lines.zh: 我拱起背，再放平，往前一寸。
lines.en: I arch my back, flatten, and gain an inch.

lines.zh: 我沿着叶脉走，脚下很稳。
lines.en: I walk along the leaf vein, steady.

lines.zh: 我的小脚一排排动，像波浪。
lines.en: My little feet move in rows, like waves.

lines.zh: 我爬过叶缘，差一点掉下去。
lines.en: I crawl over the leaf's edge and nearly fall.

lines.zh: 我先探脚，试过叶面再挪。
lines.en: I test the leaf with one foot before moving.

lines.zh: 我从一枚叶子挪到隔壁。
lines.en: I shift from this leaf to the one next door.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来，找下一口。
lines.en: I lift my head to find the next bite.
I carry my stripes along, slowly.

lines.zh: 我爬过一根细枝，抖了两下。
lines.en: I cross a thin twig and wobble twice.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边吃，路就短了。
lines.en: I eat as I go, and the way shortens.
I walk the leaf's underside; it's cool there.

lines.zh: 我把自己挪到阳光那面。
lines.en: I shift myself to the sunny side.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留着咬痕。
lines.en: Bite marks trail behind me.
I walk slowly, waiting for no one.

lines.zh: 我在叶脉交叉处停一下。
lines.en: I pause where the veins cross.
I crawl back from the leaf's tip.

lines.zh: 我趴在叶子上，一动不动。
lines.en: I lie on the leaf, unmoving.
I lift my front and sway.
I eat halfway and stop to rest.

lines.zh: 我的条纹在阳光下很亮。
lines.en: My stripes shine in the sun.
I hear a bird and curl up.

lines.zh: 我把身体贴平，装成叶子。
lines.en: I flatten myself to pass as a leaf.

lines.zh: 我贴着叶脉，慢慢磨着嘴。
lines.en: I press along the vein, slowly working my jaws.

lines.zh: 叶子有点干了，我不喜欢。
lines.en: The leaf is drying; I don't like it.
I'm thinking about becoming a butterfly.
An ant comes near; I move away.
I lower my head and chew slowly.

lines.zh: 我一节一节起伏，像在呼吸。
lines.en: I ripple segment by segment, as if breathing.

lines.zh: 借过一下，太阳照不到我了。
lines.en: Step aside; the sun no longer reaches me.
Don't touch me; I'm soft.
I'm by your hand, very small.

lines.zh: 把我挪到新叶上，我会抓稳。
lines.en: Move me to a fresh leaf and I'll hold on tight.
I lift my head; you're huge.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我的叶子。
lines.en: Your shadow covers my leaf.

lines.zh: 除了叶子，别的东西我不碰。
lines.en: Leaf and nothing else: that's all I touch.

lines.zh: 你指尖沾着叶汁，我闻得清。
lines.en: There's sap on your fingertips; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我一点点退到叶背的阴影里。
lines.en: I inch back into the shade beneath the leaf.

lines.zh: 你指尖不动，我敢再啃两口。
lines.en: If your fingers stay still, I'll risk two more bites.

lines.zh: 我团成小球，连气都不敢吐。
lines.en: I curl into a ball and don't even breathe.

lines.zh: 我的身子被压扁了一点。
lines.en: My body is a little squashed.
I've lost a few little feet.
I spit a little green juice.

lines.zh: 我拖着身子，往叶柄那面躲。
lines.en: I drag myself toward the leaf stem to hide.
That one I can't tuck my head from.
I shudder and slowly uncurl.
I bite the leaf to steady myself.
I don't cry out; I can't.
I shudder, then grip the leaf edge again.

lines.zh: 那片叶子看起来很好吃。
lines.en: That leaf looks good to eat.

lines.zh: 你手里的叶子，是给我的吗？
lines.en: That leaf in your hand; is it for me?

lines.zh: 我咬开叶脉，汁水的味道涌上来。
lines.en: I bite a vein open and the sap smell rises.
I stretch my body that way.
Only leaves; nothing else.
That one's tender; I can tell.

lines.zh: 再低半寸，我的头就够到了。
lines.en: Half an inch lower and my head reaches it.
I move over carefully.
I open my mouth for a small bite.

lines.zh: 叶尖一颤，我立刻停住嘴。
lines.en: The leaf tip trembles; I stop chewing at once.

lines.zh: 叶子一斜，我抱住叶脉没掉。
lines.en: The leaf tilts; I hug the vein and hold.
Your finger nudges me off balance.
I grip the leaf and don't fall.
One touch and I curl up.
I rest on your hand, weightless.

lines.zh: 叶子晃得厉害，我抱紧了。
lines.en: The leaf sways hard; I hold tight.
You hit the branch; I nearly drop.
I slide to the edge and crawl back.
We bump once; I'm fine.
I tuck my head in and play dead.

lines.zh: 另一条毛虫在隔壁叶上。
lines.en: Another caterpillar is on the next leaf.

lines.zh: 我们的条纹颜色差不多。
lines.en: Our stripes are about the same.
She chews one side; I chew the other.

lines.zh: 她比我胖一点，吃得也快。
lines.en: She's a bit fatter and eats faster.
We lie side by side in the sun.
She bumps her head against mine.
We crawl the same vein.
She's close to pupating and eats harder.
We hide together under the leaf.
Two caterpillars, one leaf.
I bite a leaf and drag it.

lines.zh: 我把掉下的花瓣推到一边。
lines.en: I push a fallen petal aside.
I pick up a fleck of leaf.
I grip the leaf stem with my mouth.
I drag away the thread you dropped.

lines.zh: 我抱起一滴露水，抱不住。
lines.en: I try to hold a dewdrop; it slips.

lines.zh: 我拾起一片软叶，盖在身上。
lines.en: I pick up a soft leaf and drape it over me.

lines.zh: 我把叶子卷起来，钻进去。
lines.en: I roll a leaf up and crawl inside.

lines.zh: 我把你的羽毛推到叶边。
lines.en: I push your feather to the leaf's edge.
I bite a bit of grass to taste it.
I want that leaf.

lines.zh: 我看中前面那张卷着的嫩叶。
lines.en: I've picked the curled, tender leaf ahead.
I lift my head and pick a direction.
A twig blocks me; I go around.
I crawl that way and don't look back.

lines.zh: 我认准叶缘最薄的那一段。
lines.en: I fix on the thinnest stretch of the leaf edge.
I stretch out and reach the leaf's edge.
That bird is watching; I hide first.
I've chosen the tenderest bit.
I go slowly, unhurried.
I chew my way over, fast.
I go around the vein and on.
The leaf is ahead, not far.
I stretch and bite the leaf's rim.
I eat and inch forward.
Something's under the leaf; I avoid it.
I judge the distance; I can reach.
I stop and chew twice.
That leaf sways in the wind.
I stay flat on the leaf and don't fall.
I bite once, and the leaf comes apart.
I butt the blocking leaf aside.

lines.zh: 我把身子甩过去压住它。
lines.en: I swing my body over and pin it.
I bite the vein hard.
I push once, and it flips.
My little feet hold fast.
I chew a hole and crawl through.
That bite landed true.
I pull back and catch my breath.
I roll once and flatten it.

lines.zh: 卵壳裂开，我掉在叶面上。
lines.en: The eggshell splits; I drop onto the leaf.
One more caterpillar on the leaf.
My first bite of leaf, very tender.
There are other eggshells beside me.
The sun is right; I come out to eat.
The wind on the plains is light.
I crawl under the leaf to hide first.

lines.zh: 我身上还有卵里的湿气。
lines.en: I'm still damp from the egg.
I try crawling forward a little.
This leaf will feed me a while.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的身子就干了。
lines.en: The heat dries me out at once.

lines.zh: 我从叶子上掉下去，摔在草里。
lines.en: I fall off the leaf into the grass.
Water soaks me, and I can't move.

lines.zh: 叶子被震翻，我死死咬住叶脉。
lines.en: The leaf flips; I clamp my jaws on the vein.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过叶子，我掉了下去。
lines.en: An arrow grazes the leaf; I drop.
A light covers me, and I stiffen.

lines.zh: 叶子吃完了，我越来越弱。
lines.en: The leaf is eaten; I weaken.
The lightning is too bright; I shrink into the leaf.

lines.zh: 这里没有叶子，我一直在掉。
lines.en: There are no leaves here; I keep falling.
